Q values should be set to 0.1 for 2-class classification problems, and to 0.2 for 3-class classification problems.

the Q value of the localized generalized error model (L-GEM), which is a measure of the number of unseen samples that can be correctly predicted by a given learning machine, is a nonlinear and unknown function of training data.
, for a two class problem, if the two classes are not well separated, the Q value of L-GEM should be small; and if the two classes can be separated easily, the Q value can be large.
